purpose: Lug (rectangular attachment) cases to run in the owner's licensed program with WRC 537, to benchmark the calculator's rectangular route. See docs/LUG-BENCHMARK-REQUEST.md.

settings.torsion: Mt = 0: WRC 537 gives no method for torsion on a rectangular attachment

cases.why: γ = 100 exactly and β1/β2 = 2: every Table 7/8 factor is a printed value, so programs should agree closely. Same as the hand calculation in scripts/wrc-lug-check.mjs.
γ = 62 and β1/β2 = 0.5: γ and the Table 7/8 factors are interpolated, and some Table 8 rows used are approximate (printed in parentheses). Same as the app example 'Lug, 200 × 100 mm footprint'.
γ = 50 and β1/β2 = 0.25: the edge of the WRC 537 shape range. Table 7 uses a printed row; Table 8 (β2/β1 = 4) is interpolated in γ.
L2 with a 300 × 200 × 10 mm reinforcing pad: checks the two-location pad treatment (at the lug on shell + pad, and at the pad edge).
